real.q: Better than a thousand hollow words is one word that brings peace.
Drop by drop is the water pot filled.
Irrigators channel waters; fletchers straighten arrows; the wise shape themselves.
It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
He suffers more than necessary who suffers before it is necessary.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
It never ceases to amaze me: we all love ourselves more than other people, but care more about their opinion than our own.
You could leave life right now. Let that determine what you do and say and think.
Be content with what you have; rejoice in the way things are. When you realize there is nothing lacking, the whole world belongs to you.
Do you have the patience to wait until your mud settles and the water is clear?
The best of people are like water, which benefits all things without competing.
The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
Before enlightenment, chop wood, carry water. After enlightenment, chop wood, carry water.
When walking, walk. When eating, eat.
Smile, breathe and go slowly.
Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
real.src: Thich Nhat Hanh, Stepping into Freedom

real.q: When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
real.src: Viktor Frankl, Man's Search for Meaning

real.q: Everything can be taken from a person but one thing: to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances.
real.src: Viktor Frankl, Man's Search for Meaning (paraphrased)

real.q: To go beyond is as wrong as to fall short.
He who learns but does not think is lost. He who thinks but does not learn is in great danger.
Happiness is the absence of the striving for happiness.
Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
If one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
Do the best you can until you know better. Then when you know better, do better.

modern: Rest is part of the work. Your nervous system needs it to function.
You can feel afraid and still take the next small step.
Naming a feeling out loud makes it easier for your brain to handle.
Progress that feels slow is still progress.
Compare yourself to who you were last year, not to who someone else is today.
A messy start beats a perfect plan that never begins.
Be as kind to yourself as you would be to a friend in your shoes.
Your thoughts are weather, not facts. Let them pass.
Two minutes of action beats two hours of dreading it.
Small habits repeated quietly change the whole direction of a life.
You don't need more motivation. You need a smaller first step.
Breathe out longer than you breathe in. Your body will get the message.
Boundaries are how you keep your energy for the things that matter.
Done is a gift to your future self. Perfect is a trap.
You are allowed to outgrow people, places and old versions of you.
What you do most days matters more than what you do once.
Be patient. Roots grow before anything shows above the ground.
Say it plainly: I'm doing my best, and that counts.
The goal isn't to feel nothing. It's to feel it and keep going.
Quiet confidence is built from promises you keep to yourself.
Worry borrows tomorrow's trouble and spends today's peace.
Try one thing today that your future self will thank you for.
Pause before you react. That space is where your choices live.
Gratitude doesn't erase hard days; it makes room for good ones.
Choose the next right thing, then the one after that.
You are not behind. You are on your own timeline.
Little by little is still moving.
